title: Magical Mushroom Soup
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = uncommon |collection = Mushroom 4 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|2 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |auctionable = n |sell = 4 |raw_materials = *3x [[Planks]] *1x [[Red Mushroom]] *1x [[Brown Mushroom]] *1x [[Redstone Dust]] *1x [[Glowstone Dust]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Red Mushroom *1x Brown Mushroom *1x Redstone *1x Glowstone Dust |upgrades_to = Mystical Mushroom Soup |bazaar = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' is an {{Uncommon}} consumable item unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom|4}} that allows players to fly on their {{zone|Private Island}} and {{zone|The Garden}} for 2 minutes. You can also use it while guesting someone else's Private Island or Garden. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}. However, the flight duration is limited and you should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively. It functions the same as {{Item|Mystical Mushroom Soup}}, giving you the ability to fly on player islands for 2 minutes instead of 200 minutes, but materials to craft it cost only 1/160th of Mystical Mushroom Soup. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 4}} |A1 = |B1 = Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Red Mushroom |B2 = Brown Mushroom |C2 = Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Magical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Usage == When right-clicked, the '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' is consumed, triggering its ability. When consumed, the Magical Mushroom Soup gives the player 2 minutes of flight only on their [[Private Island]] and also makes them invulnerable to fall damage. When the effects are active, players will have multi-colored particles around them. If the player leaves the island when the Magical Mushroom Soup effects are still active, the timer will pause until the player returns to the island. The time of flight left can be extended by consuming additional soup. Warning messages will trigger when there is/are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Random Message |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming when
already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == *When Magical Mushroom Soup was added, there was a bug that allowed people to use the item on the [[Hub Island]]. It was fixed shortly after. *The texture of the Magical Mushroom Soup is based on the [[terraria:Grub Soup|Grub Soup]] from Terraria. *The Magical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. **The Nausea effect has been removed and Magical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. **The custom Magical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.4|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Magical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2019/June 29|Added a limit to how far you can fly away from your island.}} {{History|2019/August 2|Give Nausea effect for 1 less second.}} {{History|2020/June 2|Flight duration is now saved when leaving private islands. Limit of one hour of flight is lifted.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}
